queries.query: How do existing cost-per-hire calculators from HR/recruiting vendors (e.g., hireTruffle and similar tools) present their line items — do they stand alone as isolated tools, or do any connect their inputs back to a broader cost-per-hire methodology or pillar content explaining hard costs vs soft costs, benchmarks, and how the number should be used?
fills: A calculator tied back to a pillar's broader cost breakdown — hiretruffle's calculator stands alone; none connect the line items to a wider cost-per-hire pillar the way this asset's angle requires.
queries.why: This is the article's gap_we_own claim — its core differentiator versus every existing cost-per-hire calculator. Confirming which competitor tools are standalone (and finding none that link back to a pillar) is essential before the asset can credibly claim this as its edge.
